title: Order line
description: One sellable item at the price and quantity the customer agreed to.

sku.description: Catalog identifier of the sellable item.

title.description: Display name captured at the moment of sale.

quantity.description: Number of units on this line.

unit-price.description: Price of one unit, captured when the line was created.

line-total.description: Quantity times unit price under the rounding policy in force. Gross: the discount below is not subtracted from it.

line-discount.description: This line's allocated share of the order's total discount, fixed when the cart became an order. Absent on an undiscounted line.

tax.description: Tax as charged on this line. Absent means not recorded, which is not the same as zero.

line-tax.description: Tax charged on one line, captured at sale. Local until a second entity needs it, at which point the promotion rule applies.

rate.description: Fraction applied, as a decimal. 0.2 is twenty percent. The rate in force at sale, never the current one.

amount.description: Tax charged on this line, already rounded under the policy in force.

jurisdiction.description: Code of the authority that levied it. Stored because a rate does not identify one, and it outlives the address it was derived from.
